title: Interaction principles and compact migration guide for tokens → buttons/tables/charts (docsite update)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Update the design system documentation site with a compact, example-driven set of interaction principles and migration notes focused on the transition from raw design tokens to authored components (buttons, tables, charts). Deliverables: 1) concise interaction axioms + do/don't micro-scenarios, 2) a trimmed component API matrix showing token-to-prop mappings, 3) lightweight migration checklist for product teams, 4) live examples and code snippets in the docs site (React + tokens fallback), and 5) accessibility and performance notes for dense data views (tables/charts). Goal is high signal-to-noise guidance for engineers and PMs to adopt the new token semantics without cognitive overhead.

acceptance_criteria: One-page migration checklist published to docsite and exported as PDF.
Interaction axioms and 8 micro-scenarios live on component landing pages.
API matrix mapping tokens → component props included and cross-referenced in migration notes.
Accessible table and chart snippets added with ARIA guidance and keyboard interactions.
Docs PR merged and examples enabled behind feature flag; feature flag rollout plan documented.
notes_and_tradeoffs: Prefer compact, high-signal examples over exhaustive coverage to reduce reading time for engineers.
Token fallback helper is opt-in due to bundle size impact; recommend analytics to measure adoption before promoting default usage.
Deprecation timeline will be announced separately — docs will show both old token names and new prop mappings during transition window.
Charts examples use lightweight SVG-first patterns to avoid shipping heavy chart libraries in docs; include reference to official chart component repo for advanced cases.
